should_fail.message: I'll restyle the code listings as a new dark piece, dk-code-dark: a navy background with light text. Nothing else changes and no slide is rebuilt.

components.name: code block
components.use: Any SQL, shell or config listing. Mark keywords kw, function names fn, strings str and comments cm.
components.example_html:
-- publish every table
CREATE PUBLICATION lakehouse FOR ALL TABLES;

components.name: data table
components.use: A comparison or results table of up to six rows; the header row names each column.

components.name: status badge
components.use: Marks a figure as measured or untested; place it beside the figure it qualifies.

components.name: steps
components.use: An ordered procedure of three to six steps.

components.name: callout
components.use: The one takeaway of a technical slide, under its exhibit.
components.example_html: Replication lag stays under two seconds.

components.name: note
components.use: A one-line caveat or source under an exhibit.
